verdict.rationale: A public feedback portal is a fair question for a product-planning tool, so the axis applies. Linear's documented Customer Requests feature is internal: it gathers asks via integrations (Slack, Intercom, Front) and manual entry, and lets the team view and filter them inside Linear. Nothing in the evidence shows a public-facing portal that a product manager can set up without engineering, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can set up a public-facing feedback portal without engineering help
